lee: Postmortem follow-up: need final owners and timelines for customer comms (status page text, 72h summary, RCA sharing). Also surface that cache pressure is a recurring pattern. Proposed owners: @ana status page, @vikram 72h, @jess + legal_team RCA policy. Ack and ETAs?

ana: Ack. I can own status page copy. Draft: 

We experienced intermittent increased latency and errors for a subset of requests. Full service restored at 10:12 UTC. Cause under investigation: prefix KV cache pressure. A 72-hour redacted summary and remediation plan will be posted.

vikram: Ack. I will draft the 72h redacted summary. Question: include logs? Legal_team, advise on redaction.

legal_team: Do not include raw traces, tokens, or internal hostnames. Enterprise customers can request deeper artifacts under contract.

jess: Comms ok with that. Suggested public RCA line: "A redacted RCA will be shared with impacted customers within 72 hours; enterprise customers may request full details via their account team."

lee: Timelines: status page final by tomorrow EOD (ana), 72h redacted summary by Fri 16:00 UTC (vikram), RCA policy language by Fri EOD (jess/legal_team). Remediation tasks: infra alerting & eviction (owner: vikram, 2w), runtime defaults review (owner: rachel, 1w), product query analysis (owner: tom, 3w). Opsbot: please create tracker tasks.

opsbot: Created INC-4502 "Customer comms + remediation tasks" assigned to ana/vikram/jess, due 2026-04-12. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4502

lee: Great. Please update tracker as you complete items. If blocked, prefix with "blocker:" so we can escalate quickly. :thumbsup:
